idempotencyKey.description: Stable client-supplied idempotency key used to collapse safe retries of the whole batch. It is scoped to the authenticated caller: the session's account, or the API key. A retry must send the same legs in the same order; different legs under the same key are refused.

legs.description: Transfers to move, in order. A batch holds at most 500 legs, debiting at most 50 distinct source account and asset pairs from at most 10 distinct source accounts. A source, destination and asset combination appears at most once; legs may otherwise repeat an asset, a source or a destination.

amount.description: Transfer amount as a positive decimal string in whole units of the asset, for example '0.5' for half a unit. At most 18 decimal places; a nonzero digit beyond the 18th is refused. Send the amount itself, not a count of smaller units: '1' transfers one whole unit.

assetId.description: Canonical public unified asset id for the asset being transferred.

Optional source public subaccount ID. When omitted, subaccount-scoped API keys use their bound subaccount; other callers use their authenticated root account. Legs of one batch may debit different source accounts.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCOUNT_SHARD_UNAVAILABLE: Funds movement for this account is temporarily unavailable. Retry later.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.BATCH_TOO_MANY_SOURCES: The batch debits more distinct source accounts than its limit of 10.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CAPITAL_VIEW_UNAVAILABLE: The account's available balance cannot be confirmed right now. Retry later.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.CONFLICT: The request conflicts with existing state.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DESTINATION_INACTIVE: The destination subaccount is not active.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DESTINATION_NOT_FOUND: The destination account or smart account could not be found.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DESTINATION_NOT_WHITELISTED: The destination is not present on the caller's internal whitelist.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DUST_BALANCE_CHANGED: A source balance moved since the quote: quote again.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DUST_BUSY: Too many dust conversions are in progress. Retry shortly.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DUST_CONVERSION_FAILED: The dust conversion could not complete. Nothing moved; quote again.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DUST_DAILY_LIMIT: The target asset's daily dust conversion limit is reached.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DUST_NOT_ELIGIBLE: A quoted balance no longer converts as dust, or the payout rounds to zero.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DUST_PRICE_MOVED: The dust conversion's payout fell more than 1% below its quote.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DUST_QUOTE_EXPIRED: The dust quote is older than 30 seconds, unknown, or another account's.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DUST_TARGET_UNAVAILABLE: The target asset cannot be paid now, or has no current price.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.DUST_WINDOW_ACTIVE: The account converted dust within the last 6 hours, or a conversion is still processing.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FAILED_PRECONDITION: A required precondition was not satisfied.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FUNDS_LOCK_CONFLICT: The funds lock conflicts with an existing or finalized reservation.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: The idempotency key was reused with different request data.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_ABANDONED: The idempotency key was abandoned with AbandonInternalTransferBatch before any batch was submitted under it. Nothing moved under the key, and nothing ever will: submit the batch under a new idempotency key.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS: The source account does not have enough available Trading balance.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INTERNAL_ERROR: The request failed because of an unexpected server error.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_REQUEST: Request payload or one of its fields is invalid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.INVALID_SUBACCOUNT_ID: The selected subaccount identifier is invalid.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.NOT_FOUND: The requested resource was not found.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PERMISSION_DENIED: Caller is not permitted to create the transfer.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.POLICY_DENIED: A required account or API-key policy rejected the transfer.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Request exceeded the applicable admission rate limit.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SAME_SOURCE_DESTINATION: Source and destination resolve to the same account.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: A required dependency is temporarily unavailable.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SMART_ACCOUNT_UNAVAILABLE: A required source or destination smart-account address is unavailable.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SOURCE_ACCOUNT_INACTIVE: The source subaccount is not active.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.STEP_UP_UNAVAILABLE: Fresh step-up verification is temporarily unavailable.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SUBACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND: The selected subaccount does not exist.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.UNSUPPORTED_ASSET: The requested asset is not supported for internal transfers.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.CREDITED: The leg is credited to its destination.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.NOT_MOVED: The leg moved nothing: its batch was refused. error_code is set on the legs that caused the refusal.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PROCESSING: The leg's outcome is the batch's, not known yet.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ABANDONED: The idempotency key was abandoned before any batch was submitted under it (AbandonInternalTransferBatch). This is final: no funds moved under the key, and none ever will; a later batch under it is refused. The answer carries no request ID and no legs.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCEPTED: Every leg is credited to its destination.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PROCESSING: The outcome is not known yet: the batch completes without the caller, ending accepted or refused. Retry with the same idempotency key to read it.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REFUSED: Nothing moved, and nothing will under this idempotency key: a leg failed its checks, a source could not cover its legs, or the batch could not complete. Legs that caused it carry their reason; the others are NOT_MOVED without one.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.ACCEPTED: The transfer request was accepted and has a durable transfer identifier.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FAILED: The transfer request failed terminally before durable acceptance.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.REJECTED: The transfer request was rejected before durable acceptance.

ApiKeyIdAuth.description: ID of the API key that signs the request. An API-key request sends it with X-API-TIMESTAMP and X-API-SIGNATURE.
ApiKeyIdAuth.name: X-API-KEY-ID

ApiKeySignatureAuth.description: Ed25519 signature of the request, made with the API key's private key and encoded as hex or base64. An API-key request sends it with X-API-KEY-ID and X-API-TIMESTAMP.
ApiKeySignatureAuth.name: X-API-SIGNATURE

ApiKeyTimestampAuth.description: Time the request was signed, in Unix milliseconds. An API-key request sends it with X-API-KEY-ID and X-API-SIGNATURE.
ApiKeyTimestampAuth.name: X-API-TIMESTAMP

BrokerApiKeyAuth.description: Broker API key, sent as a bearer token and accepted only by the QuickSwap broker API. The broker API key is a server credential. Call this API from the broker's backend, never from a browser or mobile app. The broker's members create, rotate and revoke keys through the QuickSwap broker API, and a key may rotate itself.

get.description: Read an accepted transfer by exactly one of requestId or transferId. JWT session authentication only.

parameters.description: Accepted request ID. Send exactly one of requestId or transferId.
parameters.name: requestId

parameters.description:
Source subaccount public ID; omit to read the caller's root account.

Public ID, as a base58 string.
parameters.name: subaccountId

parameters.description: Accepted ledger transfer ID. Send exactly one of requestId or transferId.
parameters.name: transferId

get.x-poly-rest-note: This operation uses REST-friendly types: decimal strings for quantities/prices, base58 strings for IDs.

post.description: Create or return one authenticated Trading to Trading internal transfer. A transfer without the recent MFA or fresh step-up it needs is refused 403 with code AUTH_MFA_ELEVATION_REQUIRED or AUTH_STEP_UP_REQUIRED.
post.x-poly-rest-note: This operation uses REST-friendly types: decimal strings for quantities/prices, base58 strings for IDs.

get.description: Read a batch's current outcome and the state of every leg by the requestId that Batch Create Internal Transfers returned, or by the idempotencyKey the caller sent it. Send exactly one of the two. The caller must be allowed to read the transfers of every source account of the batch.

parameters.description: Idempotency key the caller sent to Batch Create Internal Transfers, scoped to the caller. Send it or requestId.
parameters.name: idempotencyKey

parameters.description: Batch request ID returned by Batch Create Internal Transfers. Send it or idempotencyKey.
parameters.name: requestId

get.x-poly-rest-note: This operation uses REST-friendly types: decimal strings for quantities/prices, base58 strings for IDs.

post.description: Move up to 500 Trading to Trading transfers together, authorized by one MFA check: every leg is credited, or none moves. A batch debits at most 50 distinct source account and asset pairs from at most 10 source accounts. A batch without the recent MFA or fresh step-up it needs is refused 403 with code AUTH_MFA_ELEVATION_REQUIRED or AUTH_STEP_UP_REQUIRED.
post.x-poly-rest-note: This operation uses REST-friendly types: decimal strings for quantities/prices, base58 strings for IDs.

post.description: Make the absence of a batch under an idempotency key final. If a batch was submitted under the key, answer its outcome as Get Internal Transfer Batch reads it by key; otherwise record the key as abandoned and answer status ABANDONED: no funds moved under the key and none ever will, and every later Batch Create Internal Transfers under it is refused 400 with code IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_ABANDONED.
post.x-poly-rest-note: This operation uses REST-friendly types: decimal strings for quantities/prices, base58 strings for IDs.
